# Timber Trace Crafts

> Timber Trace Crafts is a veteran-owned small business based in Avon Park, Florida, specializing in precision laser-cut woodcrafts and custom decor. Products include handcrafted wooden jewelry (earrings, pendants), personalized jewelry boxes, and engraved tumblers.

## About

- Veteran-owned and operated, Avon Park, Florida
- Specializes in laser-cut wooden jewelry, jewelry boxes, and custom tumblers
- Materials: Maple, Baltic Birch, Basswood, cherry, walnut, oak; wood-and-resin combinations
- All pieces precision laser-cut and hand-finished
- Custom and personalized orders accepted

## Products

- Wooden earrings: dangle, drop, and stud styles in wood and resin
- Personalized jewelry boxes: engraved wooden keepsake boxes
- America 250 Tumbler: engraved tumbler commemorating the 2026 U.S. Bicentennial
- Custom laser-cut gifts: ornaments, signs, and home decor
